B. 体细胞中成对的基因一个来自父方，另一个来自母方，同源染色体也是如此 (In somatic cells paired genes one from father one from mother; homologous chromosomes likewise)
C. 不同物种的细胞中基因数量和染色体数量的比值是一定的 (In cells of different species, the ratio of number of genes to number of chromosomes is constant/fixed)

A true generally? Genes exist in pairs in somatic cells (diploid), chromosomes paired (homologous) yes. B true. C: ratio of genes to chromosomes not fixed across species? Number of genes per chromosome varies, genome sizes vary, genes many per chromosome, ratio not constant. So C likely wrong.

C is clearly false because gene/chromosome ratio not a fixed constant across species. Is that a "related inference" from Sutton? Sutton's hypothesis doesn't imply a fixed ratio. Therefore answer C.
